request.query: cart-service is returning 5xx errors after a deploy

report.summary: Cart-service experienced a sudden spike in 5xx errors immediately after the latest deployment. The spike is traced to repeated NullPointerExceptions in the PromotionEngine.applyDiscount method, which were not present in the baseline metrics.

likely_causes.title: NullPointerException in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount triggered by null promotion data
likely_causes.rationale: The deployment introduced a code change that fails to guard against null promotion objects, causing the PromotionEngine to throw a NullPointerException. This exception propagates to the HTTP layer, resulting in 5xx responses.

supporting_evidence.detail: 5xx error rate emerged from a near-zero baseline, reaching 15.00pp (threshold-validated)

likely_causes.title: Missing null-checks in PromotionEngine leading to unhandled exceptions
likely_causes.rationale: The code path in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount lacks defensive null checks for promotion data, which was exposed by the new deployment. This structural issue caused the observed errors.

supporting_evidence.detail: 5xx error rate emerged from a near-zero baseline, reaching 15.00pp (threshold-validated)

next_steps: Rollback cart-service to the last known good deployment to restore service availability.
Patch PromotionEngine.applyDiscount to include null checks for promotion data before processing.
Add unit tests covering null promotion scenarios and run them as part of CI.
Deploy the patched version after successful testing and monitor metrics for regression.
Update deployment documentation to include null-check verification as a pre-deploy check.
